selected_evidence.summary: Shows the effective 6/minute, burst-4 nftables rule and behavioral tests where initial SSH connections succeeded while excess attempts were rate-limited, including after reboot.
SSH returned a valid OpenSSH banner before and after configuration/reboot; access also resumed after rate-limit token refill.
Runtime and permanent rich rules match, unrestricted SSH service access is absent, configuration validation succeeds, and firewalld/sshd remain active.

Records the healthy pre-restart boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed post-restart boot ID, recovered services/listeners/configuration, successful SSH banner, and working post-restart rate limiting.
Confirms the temporary network namespace and virtual interface are absent.

commands.command:
set -eu
ns=[REDACTED]
host_if=antrieb_srl_h
peer_if=antrieb_srl_n
if ip netns list | awk '{print $1}' | grep -Fx "$ns" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'refusing_existing_namespace=%s\n' "$ns"; exit 10; fi
if ip link show "$host_if" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'refusing_existing_link=%s\n' "$host_if"; exit 11; fi
cleanup() { ip netns del "$ns" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; ip link del "$host_if" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$ns"
ip link add "$host_if" type veth peer name "$peer_if"
ip link set "$peer_if" netns "$ns"
ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$host_if"
ip link set "$host_if" up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$peer_if"
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set "$peer_if" up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip route add "$NODE_IP"/32 via 192.0.2.1
printf '%s\n' 'synthetic_external_route:'
ip netns exec "$ns" ip route get "$NODE_IP"
ok=0
limited=0
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 12 ]; do
  if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 2 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/"$NODE_IP"/22; IFS= read -r banner <&3; case "$banner" in SSH-*) exit 0 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac' 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'attempt_%02d=SSH_ALLOWED\n' "$i"
    ok=$((ok + 1))
  else
    printf 'attempt_%02d=RATE_LIMITED\n' "$i"
    limited=$((limited + 1))
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'rapid_summary allowed=%d rate_limited=%d\n' "$ok" "$limited"
printf '%s\n' 'waiting_11s_for_one_token_refill'
sleep 11
if ip netns exec "$ns" timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/"$NODE_IP"/22; IFS= read -r banner <&3; case "$banner" in SSH-*) printf "refill_banner=%s\\n" "$banner"; exit 0 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac'; then refill=allowed; else refill=failed; fi
printf 'post_refill_connection=%s\n' "$refill"
[ "$ok" -ge 1 ] && [ "$limited" -ge 1 ] && [ "$refill" = allowed ]
